فملی.core_hypothesis: The non-obvious edge is not simply higher copper prices; it is the combination of strong sales growth, volume-led expansion, copper-price sensitivity, and leadership in a broad market risk-on regime. A pullback after a leader day can be accumulation rather than weakness, but only if price/volume and real-money flow confirm it.

hidden_signal.name: volume_quality_not_price_headline
hidden_signal.logic: Prioritize sales-volume effect over headline copper-price narratives. If revenue accelerates while volume contribution dominates, the thesis is stronger and less dependent on a single commodity-price spike.
confirmation: monthly sales keeps setting higher highs
price advances with improving turnover rather than only gap-up behavior
invalidation: sales growth rolls over for two consecutive releases
volume falls while revenue is supported only by price
copper price breaks down materially and remains weak
stock leadership disappears while market breadth remains healthy

event_chain: global copper supply disruption or tightness
fund-flow rotation toward large liquid commodity leaders
option convexity increases demand for calls

strategy.stock: Scale in only on confirmed support/accumulation; avoid chasing an extended green candle. Increase exposure after a high-volume close above confirmation.
strategy.option: Use options only when spot confirms direction; prioritize delta, IV, theta, open-interest concentration and spread liquidity. Avoid buying high-IV calls solely because copper is bullish.
strategy.risk: If 18800 fails on expanding volume, downgrade the thesis and reduce directional exposure. If price rises while real-money flow deteriorates sharply, treat the move as distribution risk.
